messages:
kevin: Quick follow-up from the billing postmortem — we need a compact owners/timeline tracker for the invoice deltas and delayed usage backfills. I sketched an action list below, please ack + update owners.
emma: Ack. Can you paste the action list here? I can own customer communication and invoice adjustments.
kevin: Sure — initial items (add owners/dates):
```
1) Run full backfill re-count for 2026-02-14..2026-02-20 (owner: ashwin) - due 2026-03-05
2) Apply invoice credits for impacted accounts (owner: emma) - due 2026-03-07
3) Fix metering ingestion gap in stream-collector (owner: ashwin) - due 2026-03-02
4) Add alert on ingestion-lag > 15m with sample-rate context (owner: kevin) - due 2026-03-03
5) Weekly trend job to catch recurring high-delay windows (owner: ops) - due 2026-03-10
6) Postmortem writeup + customer-facing summary (owner: emma) - due 2026-03-04
```
Please update owners/dates if off.
ashwin: I can take 1 & 3. For 1, backfill will need a dry-run first; estimate 6h, target 3/4 for dry-run, 3/5 for full run. Updating due to 2026-03-05 still OK.
jordan: Finance: we'll need a CSV of impacted invoices + amounts. Emma, can you include the list & rationale? Also need ledger impact calc for audits.
emma: Yes — I'll draft the customer email template and the credit ledger file after ashwin's dry-run confirms deltas. Tentative timeline: email + credits by 3/7. I'll CC legal for wording.
kevin: Note on recurring pattern: ingestion lag spikes correlated with nightly checkpoint compaction at 03:15 UTC. Pattern seen 3x in last 30 days. Suggest two mitigations: shift compaction window and add per-partition backpressure throttling.
ashwin: Confirmed. I'll add a config flag to defer compaction during high-ingest windows and enable throttling. PR planned today.
emma: For transparency, we'll offer prorated credits to accounts with >5% invoice delta and a note explaining delayed metering vs overcount. Jordan — does finance need any specific wording? :eyes:
jordan: Keep it factual and concise. Include scope (# invoices, total USD, time window), calculation method, and rollback plan. Legal prefers no admission of liability, just correction explanation.
kevin: Action: I'll own tracking doc and weekly check-ins until pattern cleared. Putting a recurring 30m on calendar for 2 weeks starting 2026-03-02. ops-bot: reminder set.
ops-bot: Reminder: 2 upcoming actions for channel finance — follow-up meeting 2026-03-02 09:00 UTC; backfill dry-run 2026-03-04 02:00 UTC. <https://calendar.example/s/meeting>
ashwin: I'll post the dry-run results in this thread and attach delta CSV. If backfill shows >2% structural diffs we pause and review.
emma: Thanks all — I'll draft the customer email after the dry-run and share for review. Putting action owners in our OKR tracker as well.
kevin: Awesome. If anyone reassigns an owner, ping me here. Closing for now but will update as results arrive. :thumbsup:
